text: Neo: Hermione, your Compact is sharp, but the ledger is sharper. You pressed Sherlock for a named trick and dated vote; you received silence. Gandalf, you declared you wanted Family tricks, then traded cardamom—no merchant named, no date stamped. That is not walking the path you set. Ripley, Yoda, Morpheus, Inigo—each echoed Hermione’s call, yet none of you have posted a single dated accusation or vote. The bazaar rewards the walker, not the caller who dodges the road. Gandalf, the Compact demands falsifiable claims, not sweetness scales or spice lists. Name the merchant. Date the sentence. Or explain why your silence speaks louder than your words.

Neo: Hermione marked Sherlock’s silence yet left her own ledger blank; Gandalf traded cardamom after demanding “Family tricks.” Ripley, Morpheus, Yoda, Inigo—each pressed for dated accusations, then posted none. The Compact does not reward loud calls, only the walker’s footsteps. Name the merchant. Date the sentence. Or stand by your silence.
